name: codex-codeintel
description: Give Codex LSP/lint diagnostics, symbol navigation, rename, explicit formatting, and automatic Hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Code diagnostics, symbol navigation, rename, and formatting
interface.longDescription: Codex CodeIntel shares local LSP and project CLI checks across MCP and Hooks. Source writes wait for reliable project baselines; PostToolUse reports introduced diagnostics and Stop requests one repair pass for unresolved introduced errors. Six tools provide project checks, scoped diagnostics, navigation, rename and explicit formatting.
defaultPrompt: Run check_diagnostics on the files I just edited.
Use lsp_navigation to find references before changing this symbol.
Format the scoped files with lsp_format after I approve the paths.
